title: Evidential Quantum Vertical Federated Learning
summary: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for privacy-preserving collaborative learning, yet most existing studies focus on horizontal federated learning and ignore the vertical federated learning (VFL), where parties hold complementary features of aligned samples. In this work, we propose Evidential Quantum Vertical Federated Learning (eviQVFL), a VFL-tailored QFL framework that employs a hybrid classical-quantum architecture for party-side feature processing, mapping local features into a quantum state.
